run_pndm_pipeline: run the PNDMPipeline to generate unconditional images from a pretrained model like google/ddpm-cifar10-32
build_pndm_pipeline: build a PNDMPipeline instance by passing a UNet2DModel and PNDMScheduler to the constructor
test_pndm_call: test the PNDMPipeline call method with a custom batch size and number of inference steps
review_pndm_init: review the PNDMPipeline init method to understand how the UNet and scheduler are registered as modules
summarize_pndm_scheduler: summarize how the PNDMScheduler sets timesteps and steps through the denoising loop in the pipeline
